description: This file defines an extension method for configuring transaction support in a silo builder within the Orleans hosting framework. It adds transaction-related services and grain extensions to the silo configuration.

classes.name: SiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: Provides extension methods for configuring the Orleans silo builder, specifically for enabling transaction support.

methods.name: UseTransactions
methods.description: Configures the silo builder to use distributed transaction management by adding relevant services and grain extensions.
